title: Riyadh financial district targeted, Aramco skyscraper damaged
summary: RIYADH – An Aramco building in Riyadh was targeted in an “attempted attack”, the Saudi energy ministry said on Sunday, with eyewitnesses telling AFP the skyscraper sustained damage,…

blocks.text: RIYADH – An Aramco building in Riyadh was targeted in an “attempted attack”, the Saudi energy ministry said on Sunday, with eyewitnesses telling AFP the skyscraper sustained damage, after the Saudi-led coalition fighting Yemen’s Houthis said it had intercepted missiles launched by the group. Aramco facilities and infrastructure have been repeatedly struck by the Houthis
